g.text: Compiler latency: old and new images versus TypeScript
Two inputs; 3 fresh processes per role/input. Bars are medians; whiskers are observed min–max, not confidence intervals.
Later statistic: median across 3 process medians, each from 3 later requests. These windows are still warming.
